_about: t25 (card experiments/t25_one_frame_one_scan/, D91): t21_pair4.json (the t21 pair-P4 recipe: warm start runs/t20_base_s0, 1500 steps, lr 1e-4, warm-up 100, ema 0.99, clips of 3 keyframes, GT v13 / lane l6 as the t20 chain) with batch_size 2 and accum 3 (the same 6 clips per step as batch 3 and accum 2; the recursive arms do not fit at batch 3, t21_rec.json) and n_cam 3 and cam_stride 2 (the t21_rec.json frame chain, 6 Hz) and model.cam_buffer 'recurrent' (each frame lifted once and fused with the previous fused state; no new camera parameter, the warm start loads exactly). Arm R' of the card (attribution): the recursive camera with the unchanged 0.5 s radar window (radar_window 0.5), no radar memory (rad_temporal none).
